evidence:
Walked every scored and gate criterion against the frozen golden source and seed. No criterion found that the reference cannot satisfy.

GATES. hro_gate_render: bad password returns 401 'That email and password do not match an account.' (src/index.js:87), shown in #login-error (app.js:206); valid sign-in renders the Board. hro_gate_shared: POST /api/jobs and /api/applications persist in SQLite (index.js:202-233); Observer bootstrap returns all jobs and applications (index.js:178-191).

FUNCTIONAL, by protocol.
S: blank title rejected by text() (index.js:62-64); places 0/51 rejected by the integer range check (index.js:207); '2.5' fails the client /^\d+$/ test, becomes NaN, serialises to null and is refused server-side (board.js:72, index.js:207). Add-candidate appends at the bottom of Applied (index.js:229). Invalid or case-duplicate email returns field 'candidate_email' (index.js:221-224). The client writes that to email.fault and keeps the typed name, which is cleared only on success (board.js:53-57). The same email on another job is allowed (UNIQUE(job_id,candidate_email), db.js:38).
M: only adjacent stages are offered (board.js:144-158); a skip is refused 409 (index.js:253-254). Arrivals append to the bottom (index.js:305). Up/Down buttons reorder (board.js:233-241) and the order is server-persisted. Blank reject is refused client-side and server-side (board.js:229, index.js:250). The reason and Rejected-from appear on the card and in the details (board.js:131,255). A Hired card is not offered Reject, and a forged rejection is refused (board.js:151, index.js:249). Reopen is offered only to rejected_from and other targets are refused (board.js:148, index.js:251-252). Reopen clears the reason (index.js:311-313); undo restores stage, rejected_from and reason from before_json (index.js:301-302,352).
L: the capacity check covers the whole set (index.js:289-294). Re-ordering inside Interview has entering=0, so it is allowed. Undo is refused when returning cards would overfill Interview (index.js:344-346). Put-back: the client restores the snapshot, shows r.data.error in the alert and focuses the card's select (board.js:191-198, fail() 166-171), so document.activeElement is inside the card.
C: the version check runs before any write, and the message names the actor from the latest activity line, e.g. 'F was changed by someone else (Mei Lin moved F from Screen to Applied)' (index.js:241-245).
B: bulk input is sorted by stage index then position (index.js:283-287 and board.js:286). The bulk move is all-or-nothing in one .immediate() transaction (index.js:273-319). Undo reinserts cards at their saved indices sorted ascending, so V returns to the top and W,X,Y return to their places (index.js:350). Undo is refused when any card's version != version_after (index.js:341-342). It is single-use and only the latest action counts (myUndo index.js:165-168; undo 337-338).
A: activity lines name the actor and stages for every kind (describe index.js:265-270; job/add 211,230; undo 353). Refusals throw before log() or roll back. The view is newest first with a per-job filter (app.js:45-85).
N: notes are allowed for recruiters and the job's own manager, other managers get 403, and the Observer can read (index.js:363-373, board.js:137).
R: manager role rules (index.js:257-263, board.js targets/mayReorder). Observer and candidate get 403 on move/add/note. Anonymous requests get 401 on bootstrap/move/add/note/message (auth(), index.js:73-81).
V: an SSE 'changed' event follows each successful write and triggers a refresh within 300ms (index.js:47-53, app.js:133-157). It streams through the bootstrap proxy (bootstrap.js:28-41). Scripted arrival time was 808ms.
T: Enter sends and Shift+Enter keeps the newline (threads.js:183). Body newlines are preserved except trailing whitespace (index.js:399), rendered with pre-wrap (styles.css .message .body). The box is cleared and refocused (threads.js:195-200). Blank sends are refused (threads.js:189, index.js:396). Messages page 30 at a time with earlier_count (index.js:384-391); the button reads 'Show earlier messages (N more)' (threads.js:87). Thread access: Ingrid's thread=null so it is not listed and is refused 403 (index.js:114-131). The Observer gets read-only (threads.js:140-142). Drafts are stored in localStorage keyed by user id and thread (app.js:39-43, threads.js:112,124,182).
U: seed parse confirms Mei Lin read_count 1 of 3 on APP-201 (Tomas, Data Analyst), which gives exactly 2 unread from Tomas. Unread excludes the person's own messages (index.js:133), and sending marks the thread read (index.js:400). A thread stays unread while the Board is the active view because catchUp marks read only when active (threads.js:151-158). Scrolled-up arrival increments pending, shows the 'N new message' pill and does not mark read until scrolled to the bottom (threads.js:152-158,177-181). Seen uses the candidate's read marker only, so the Observer never counts (index.js:143-150).
K: the candidate bootstrap returns only id, job_title, team, LABELS[stage] and the thread summary (index.js:171-176). Card-detail is STAFF-only (403, index.js:363). Another application's thread returns 404 for a candidate (index.js:127). Candidate linkage uses the email lookup (index.js:225).
D: SQLite at DB_PATH, seedIfEmpty only when users is empty (db.js:9,61-62).

POLISH. live_board: renderBoard leaves the detail aside and note textarea alone, and loadNotes runs only when note_count changes (board.js:124-141,321-341). live_thread: messages are appended, and the box and focus are untouched (threads.js:145-159). earlier_place: scrollTop is compensated by the height delta (threads.js:167-171), and the scripted getBoundingClientRect check passed (workspace.cjs:278-282). failed_send: an aborted fetch returns status 0 with an explanation and the box is kept (app.js:31, threads.js:194); the unsaved card note persists via keep 'note.'+id (board.js:98,120). session_resume: a 401 calls sessionLost(), which shows the sign-in prompt; drafts are per user id, so Mei sees none (app.js:34,187-195).
VISUAL: a coherent tokenised palette and type scale (styles.css :root, h1-h3) plausibly scores mid or high; this is likert craft and is not measured.

Runtime: the raw-evidence-index artifacts hash-match, and their source hashes equal the frozen solution bytes. 18 scripted golden groups passed with no page errors (workspace.json). That run is scripted Playwright/API, not a configured claude-code judge run.

Risk=true for these reasons:
(1) No full configured judge/Oracle run exists for these bytes (raw-evidence-index scope says Oracle/full grading absent), so 'the oracle can score high' is source-plausible but unmeasured.
(2) hro_unread_counts depends on Mei's seeded 2-unread on APP-201 surviving earlier suites. Gates do not touch it, but if rewardkit ran polish before functional and the hro_pol_session_resume judge happened to use Tomas's Data Analyst conversation as Mei, her count would be 0 before functional. The scored suite order (presumably functional, polish, visual alphabetically) was not verified.
(3) The Activity view truncates to 50 rows with a visible 'Show more (N earlier)' button (app.js:46,79-83). The estimated J1 count is about 40 lines, so filtering per job is fine, but a judge reading the All-jobs view without expanding might see truncation. This is low risk.
The scripted driver does not exercise polish failed_send (abort), and covers that row only by source reading.

Counterexample probes. A broken golden that could still pass: none found for this row's concern. A conforming alternative that could fail is a different row's concern (criteria are browser-observable and route-agnostic). Neither revealed a criterion the reference cannot meet.
run_verdict: PARTIAL — scripted golden run on frozen bytes CONFIRMS the main behaviours (18/18 groups, arrival 808ms, earlier-place getBoundingClientRect, session-resume, restart); full configured judge/Oracle run NOT EXERCISED
